verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly publish a machine-readable API (for example, for processing times or application status), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API, an OpenAPI spec, or any downloadable machine-readable interface. The cited material describes only human-facing web pages, questionnaires and a public processing-time checker.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
